messages:
sam_sales: Procurement at NovaTrust blocked the POC over a SIG line asking for HSM attestation for any inference cache. They want vendor-signed risk acceptance if HSM not possible. Need a short customer paragraph + internal sign-off path.

dita_seceng: Acknowledged. Can you paste the exact ask?

sam_sales: 'Confirm support for customer-managed HSM attestation for transient caches and persisted token-like artifacts; if not available, provide compensating controls and vendor-signed risk acceptance.'

omar_prod: Short summary: hosted = no HSM for ephemeral caches; Dedicated/Private can attach customer HSM for persisted storage. Proposed compensating controls (internal): ephemeral-only cache, default TTL 30s configurable to 10s, no disk persistence, CMEK for persisted blobs, mTLS + least-privilege, immutable audit logs, manual signed runtime snapshot on request.

dita_seceng: Residual risk = "moderate-elevated" for financial customers. I can draft the internal risk memo and request CISO sign-off; will include remediation plan to automate attestation (ETA ~8 weeks).

jules_legal: External-friendly paragraph suggestion: "Hosted Redwood inference uses transient, in-memory caches with strict isolation and short TTLs. Hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is available via Dedicated/private deployments; for hosted deployments, Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, enhanced auditability, and can furnish a vendor-signed risk acceptance for POC deployments. Contact your account team to discuss Dedicated/private options."

ops-bot: Created SEC-2266 and assigned to dita_seceng, jules_legal, ciso.

sam_sales: Thanks — can you drop the internal memo + final customer paragraph in this thread ASAP? Procurement needs this today."
